precheck.description: ensure table "Task" has exactly the columns the rebuild copies or leaves out (completedAt, createdAt, details, failureMessage, failureSummary, forceRefresh, id, kind, parentTaskId, progressCompleted, progressTotal, retryCount, sourceId, sourceName, startedAt, status, title, titleMessage, updatedAt)
precheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('Task')) = 19 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('Task') WHERE name IN ('completedAt', 'createdAt', 'details', 'failureMessage', 'failureSummary', 'forceRefresh', 'id', 'kind', 'parentTaskId', 'progressCompleted', 'progressTotal', 'retryCount', 'sourceId', 'sourceName', 'startedAt', 'status', 'title', 'titleMessage', 'updatedAt')) = 19

execute.description: create new table "_prisma_new_Task" with desired schema
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_Task" (
  "completedAt" TEXT,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) NOT NULL,
  "details" TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
  "failureMessage" TEXT,
  "failureSummary" TEXT,
  "forceRefresh" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ownerUserId" TEXT,
  "parentTaskId" TEXT,
  "progressCompleted" INTEGER,
  "progressTotal" INTEGER,
  "retryCount" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sourceId" TEXT,
  "sourceName" TEXT,
  "startedAt" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "titleMessage" TEXT,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("ownerUserId") REFERENCES "User" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL
)
